title: Chart Feature Spec
description: One feature spec, produced by the generate-chart-spec skill from gathered design tokens/requirements, reviewed via PR, then consumed by the implement-new-* skills. See planning/specs/README.md for the full workflow and field-by-field guidance.

id.description: Kebab-case slug, matches the filename without extension.

chartType.description: Matches an existing markType, or 'chart' for a chart-level (not mark-specific) feature. Also determines the planning/specs/<chartType>/ directory the file lives in.

status.description: Defaults to 'approved' — a spec only lands in main once its PR is reviewed, so draft/in-review states are represented by the PR itself, not this field. Move to 'implemented' once the feature PR lands, or 'needs-revision' if the spec is found stale/wrong.

score.description: 1-2 simple (plain passthrough prop), 3 moderate (new logic in one spec-builder function), 5 complex (new mark/child component or cross-cutting change). See README.md rubric.

rationale.description: Short free-text justification for the score.

requirements.description: Behavior requirements gathered in phase 1, one per entry.

edgeCases.description: See README.md for the standard edge-case checklist (empty data, single point, many series, long labels, breakpoints, light/dark background, S1/S2 parity, accessibility, interaction conflicts).

touchesHoverAnimation.description: The mouse-hover animation system (isAnimate gate, hoverAnimationUtils.ts, usermeta.animatedMark).

touchesControlledHighlight.description: The externally-controlled highlight system (CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_TABLE/SERIES), driven by props/state rather than mouse position.

touchesTooltipOrPopover.description: The interactive-mark system (isInteractive, voronoi hover overlay, interactiveMarkName, COMPONENT_NAME popover-content matching).

requiresNewSignalOrScale.description: A new Vega signal (needs a symmetric set/clear) or a new/extended facet scale (color/lineType/opacity).

requiresS1S2Parity.description: Whether the corresponding vega-spec-builder (s1) file needs the mirrored change.

notes.description: Free-text elaboration for any flag set to true above.

change.description: Description of what changes in this file.

lines.description: Approximate line range at time of authoring, e.g. '88-129'. May drift — re-locate by symbol name if stale.

openQuestions.description: Anything unresolved that reviewers should weigh in on.
